## Summary

[Partial] Connect wires from a Daystar KU800 switch to terminal A and B, then plug into fuse box slot C. [t1039]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Connect one end of wire 1409974021 to terminal A on the switch.
2. [Partial] Attach a second piece of wire from terminal B on the switch to the light bar connector.
3. [Partial] Secure the wiring harness near the dashboard using zip ties.
4. [Partial] Plug the main power input into the vehicle's fuse box slot C.
5. [Partial] Turn the ignition key to position D and flip the new switch up once.
6. [Partial] Observe if the 20-inch light bar illuminates brightly.
7. [Partial] If dim, swap wire positions at terminal E on the harness connector.
8. Test all three settings by cycling through low, high, and off modes.

_Procedure reported by [t1039]._
